verdicts.reason: A: the headline is barely bigger than the body copy, so the hierarchy falls apart. The left column (logo, sale ribbon, small can) is cramped, while the right column has no shared edge: the headline is centred, the CTA is offset to the left and the legal text drifts right, with dead space underneath. B: the large two-line headline gives it strong hierarchy and a sensible banner layout. Its flaws: the product is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail in the top-right corner, the body copy wraps with a short orphan line ('on June 21.'), the CTA almost touches the right edge, and the headline sits tight to the bottom edge.
